feeds.title: FrontPage Magazine
feeds.description: The magazine's coverage of and commentary about events has been greatly augmented over the last two years by the presence of nine Shillman Fellows in Journalism underwritten by board member Dr. Robert Shillman. FrontPage has recently added a blog called 'The Point,' run by Shillman Fellow Daniel Greenfield, which has tripled web traffic. For over 20 years, FrontPage Magazine has been the internet's go-to source for conservative political commentary.

feeds.title: American Thinker
feeds.description: American Thinker is a daily internet publication devoted to the thoughtful exploration of issues of importance to Americans. Our contributors are accomplished in fields beyond journalism and animated to write for the general public out of concern for the complex and morally significant questions on the national agenda.

feeds.title: Hugh Hewitt
feeds.description: It's no easy task to wake up an entire nation, but Hugh Hewitt is a broadcast pro who does it with ease on over 450 affiliates coast-to-coast Monday through Friday. Hugh also hosts two podcasts daily - 'Highly Concentrated Hugh' which is a short version of the morning radio show and 'The Interview with Hugh Hewitt' - a long-form interview with a guest from politics or the arts. Hugh Hewitt now has a website where he shares his views and conducts interviews, podcasts, and more.

feeds.title: California Republican Assembly
feeds.description: Since 1935, California Republican Assembly has been working to elect Republican candidates who stand resolutely for Republican principles. As California's oldest and most influential Republican volunteer organization, CRA's endorsement is a coveted privilege for those candidates who meet our high standards. Our membership is comprised of activists, business owners, and community leaders who are active in local chapters throughout California. Read about the latest news, events, endorsements, and more.

feeds.title: Flash Report Blog
feeds.description: Jon Fleischman is the founder and publisher of FlashReport which has a primary mission of sharing and discussing California's most significant political news with people.

feeds.title: Orange Juice Blog
feeds.description: The Orange Juice Blog stands as Orange County's pioneering platform for political news and perspectives, earning the moniker 'the OC's political mosh pit.' Established in 2003, it remains the region's foremost political blog, offering a diverse array of viewpoints and fostering robust discourse on local issues.

feeds.title: Dennis Prager
feeds.description: Dennis Prager is one of the most respected and influential thinkers, writers, and speakers in America. He is a nationally syndicated talk show host. Fiercely independent, Prager's opinions, intellect, and integrity have influenced millions of lives through books, lectures, and broadcasts, available on his website.
